nodes.name: TRG_Start
nodes.notes: Entry point for sub-workflow. Receives input from parent workflow's Execute Workflow node.

nodes.name: INP_ValidateAndRoute
nodes.notes: Validates input parameters, normalizes structure, and adds metadata for routing.

nodes.name: SW_ModeRouter
nodes.notes: Routes workflow based on mode (EXTRACT_CONTENT or CREATE_FILE). First checks validation status.

nodes.name: ERR_PackValidationError
nodes.notes: Packages validation errors into standard output format

nodes.name: GD_DownloadFile
nodes.notes: Downloads file from Google Drive. Converts Google Docs/Slides to PDF, Sheets to XLSX.

nodes.name: ERR_PackDownloadError
nodes.notes: Packages download error into standard error format for final output.

nodes.name: SW_MimeTypeRouter
nodes.notes: Routes file to appropriate extraction node based on MIME type detected from binary data.

nodes.name: XTR_FromPDF
nodes.notes: Extracts text from PDF files using OCR and text extraction. Joins all pages into single text.

nodes.name: XTR_FromText
nodes.notes: Extracts text from plain text and markdown files. Preserves formatting.

nodes.name: XTR_FromDoc
nodes.notes: Extracts text from Microsoft Word documents (.doc, .docx).

nodes.name: XTR_FromCSV
nodes.notes: Extracts structured data from CSV files. Converts to JSON array.

nodes.name: XTR_FromXLS
nodes.notes: Extracts data from legacy Excel files (.xls). Converts to structured data.

nodes.name: XTR_FromXLSX
nodes.notes: Extracts data from modern Excel files (.xlsx). Converts to structured data.

nodes.name: XTR_Unsupported
nodes.notes: Handles unsupported file types by returning error with MIME type info.

nodes.name: OUT_PackExtraction
nodes.notes: Packages extraction results into standard output format with metadata and error tracking.

nodes.name: SW_DocumentTypeRouter
nodes.notes: Routes to appropriate document creation path based on document_type (google_doc, google_slides, google_sheet).

nodes.name: DOC_CheckTemplate
nodes.notes: Checks if reference template URL is provided. Routes to copy template or create new doc.

nodes.name: GD_CopyDocTemplate
nodes.notes: Copies template file into target folder with timestamped name.

nodes.name: DOC_CreateNewDoc
nodes.notes: Creates new blank Google Doc in target folder when no template provided.

nodes.name: DOC_PrepareContent
nodes.notes: Processes input_json and generates formatted text content for insertion into Google Doc.

nodes.name: DOC_UpdateContent
nodes.notes: Inserts generated content into Google Doc using Google Docs API.

nodes.name: SLIDES_CheckTemplate
nodes.notes: Checks if reference template URL is provided for slides. Routes to copy or create new.

nodes.name: GD_CopySlideTemplate
nodes.notes: Copies slide template into target folder.

nodes.name: SLIDES_CreateNew
nodes.notes: Creates new blank Google Slides presentation. Uses HTTP Request to Google Slides API.

nodes.name: SLIDES_PrepareContent
nodes.notes: Simplified slides preparation - passes through for now. Full implementation requires Google Slides API batch updates.

nodes.name: SHEET_CheckTemplate
nodes.notes: Checks if reference template URL is provided for sheet.

nodes.name: GD_CopySheetTemplate
nodes.notes: Copies sheet template into target folder.

nodes.name: SHEET_CreateNew
nodes.notes: Creates new blank Google Sheet using Google Sheets node.

nodes.name: SHEET_PrepareContent
nodes.notes: Converts input_json to tabular data for sheet insertion.

nodes.name: SHEET_UpdateContent
nodes.notes: Appends rows to Google Sheet.

nodes.name: OUT_PackCreation
nodes.notes: Packages CREATE_FILE results into standard output format.

nodes.name: OUT_Final
nodes.notes: Final output node - combines all paths (validation errors, extract results, create results) into single standardized response.

nodes.name: ERR_CheckDownloadError
nodes.notes: Checks if download failed (permission denied, file not found, etc.). Routes to error handler if failed.
